headline: AI-chip rout sent the S&P 500 down 4.4% Thursday, its worst day since April 2025, and the October jobs report lands at 8:30 AM ET today.
rates: The 10-year Treasury yield fell to about 4.84% Thursday from 4.90%, as money moved to safety, after topping 5.30% last month.
fed: The Fed held at 3.75%-4.00% on Oct 28 with two dissents favoring a hike, futures leaned toward a December 9 hike before the selloff, and no Fed speakers were confirmed.
oil: Brent rose 3.9% to about $98.29 Thursday, recovering part of Wednesday's near-9% drop, on uncertainty over the Iran war and when energy markets normalize.
geo: The Iran war keeps driving oil and inflation worries, and Democratic midterm wins raised the risk of government pauses on AI data-center construction.
